note: One casting of a spell: which spell, who cast it, at what, and the timings a client plays it out with.

fields.name: size
fields.note: How many bytes this whole shape occupies, counting these two.

fields.name: spell
fields.note: Which spell, by the number the client knows it as.

fields.name: cast
fields.note: The name this casting answers to, so later messages can name it.

fields.name: level
fields.note: The level the spell stands at.

fields.name: attackSpeed
fields.note: What the caster's attack rhythm is scaled by while this runs.

fields.name: caster
fields.note: The unit casting.

fields.name: chainOwner
fields.note: The unit the casting is credited to, where a chain of casts leads back to another.

fields.name: package
fields.note: Which set of art and sound the client draws it with.

fields.name: missile
fields.note: The name the missile this casting throws will answer to, or zero where it throws none.

fields.name: targetX
fields.note: Where the casting is aimed, along one ground axis.

fields.name: targetY
fields.note: Where the casting is aimed, in height.

fields.name: targetZ
fields.note: Where the casting is aimed, along the other ground axis.

fields.name: targetEndX
fields.note: Where the casting stops being aimed, for a spell that sweeps, along one ground axis.

fields.name: targetEndY
fields.note: Where the casting stops being aimed, for a spell that sweeps, in height.

fields.name: targetEndZ
fields.note: Where the casting stops being aimed, for a spell that sweeps, along the other ground axis.

fields.name: hitCount
fields.note: How many units the casting names as hit.

fields.name: hits
fields.note: The units the casting names as hit.

fields.name: castTime
fields.note: How long the casting takes before it takes effect, in seconds.

fields.name: extraCastTime
fields.note: What is added to that, in seconds.

fields.name: totalTime
fields.note: How long the whole casting runs, in seconds.

fields.name: cooldown
fields.note: How long until the spell can be cast again, in seconds.

fields.name: startedAt
fields.note: When the casting began, in seconds.

bits.name: basicAttack
bits.note: Set where the casting is the caster's own swing rather than a spell.

bits.name: secondBasicAttack
bits.note: Set where the swing is the second of a pair.

bits.name: forced
bits.note: Set where the casting was not asked for by whoever holds the caster.

bits.name: overrideCastPosition
bits.note: Set where the aim above replaces the one the caster would have used.

bits.name: clicked
bits.note: Set where a click chose the aim.

bits.name: unknown
bits.note: Purpose undetermined. A server leaves these as it found them, so they carry values it never wrote for this message.

fields.name: slot
fields.note: Which of the caster's slots the spell sits in.

fields.name: cost
fields.note: What the casting spends from the caster's resource.

fields.name: launchX
fields.note: Where what the casting throws leaves from, along one ground axis.

fields.name: launchY
fields.note: Where what the casting throws leaves from, in height.

fields.name: launchZ
fields.note: Where what the casting throws leaves from, along the other ground axis.

fields.name: ammoUsed
fields.note: How many charges the casting spends.

fields.name: ammoRecharge
fields.note: How long until a spent charge returns, in seconds.
